title: Vintage San Francisco Postcards Fort Point Booklet + Cable Car Alcatraz Hyde St
condition_description: Booklet complete and intact, no cards detached; cable car card unposted and blank. Light toning and a faint stain along one edge of the booklet back (pictured).
description:
Vintage San Francisco postcard lot:

1) Souvenir postcard booklet - "6 Detachable Post Cards, Fort Point National Historic Site, San Francisco, California", original 50 cent cover price. Photos by Pierre Atlan (P-24).

Views include:
- Cannon Rooms, Fort Point
- Aerial View - the Golden Gate
- 12 Pounder Napoleon Cannon
- Aerial View of Fort Point
- Sally Port Entrance, Fort Point

2) "Cable Car, San Francisco Hill & Alcatraz Island" - the cable car climbing the steep Hyde St. hill with Alcatraz and the Bay behind. Smith Novelty Co., San Francisco, P86257, Plastichrome by Colourpicture, color by John H. Atkinson, Jr. Deckle edges, unposted and blank.

Condition: booklet complete and intact - no cards detached, none written on or posted. Light toning and a faint stain along one edge of the back (see photos).

Ships flat with a stiffener in a protective mailer.
